name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Lead Qualification Hard Gate separates need detection from actual sales qualification.
PASS requires Buyer Role=Co, Product Fit=Co and deterministic score >=65; FAIL/WATCH never enter KH PASS counters.
Score components: Need 25 + Product Fit 25 + Action 20 + Urgency 15 + Reachability 10 + Freshness 5.
Per-Group AI Context / Offer in QUET NHOM is the primary Product Fit context; global Business Context is fallback. With no context, Product Fit is forced to Chua ro.
AI mode is explicit: AUTO analyzes only pending sources from Groups just scanned; MANUAL lets the operator choose checked Groups, selected CO HOI rows, all waiting sources, or legacy requalification.
Manual JSON import is fallback ingestion and does not auto-run AI.
KHACH HANG TIEM NANG preserves old rows as LEGACY until they are explicitly requalified; PASS metrics exclude LEGACY.
Operator menu bootstrap is simplified to 1 Settings, 2 Scan Group, 3 AI Analysis, 4 Refresh Data; diagnostics/import/dedupe/version are moved under tools/system.
